title: Hoodie — Front, Left-Breast Lockup
prompt: Premium product mockup of a heavyweight pullover hoodie in deep teal-black (#0A1A1F), double-lined hood with flat drawcords and a kangaroo pocket, shown flat top-down on a soft neutral studio surface with gentle directional light and realistic brushed-fleece texture. On the wearer's left breast: the Ongea Pesa orbital emblem (glowing cyan #22D3EE core into teal #0FB5A6, soundwave arcs, green-to-cyan orbit ring, soft halo) above the white 'ONGEA PESA' wordmark in geometric uppercase, and directly below a small 'by NSAIT' endorser mark in a violet-to-blue gradient (#6D28D9 to #2563EB) with a tiny sparkle glyph. Chest graphic ~90mm wide, premium streetwear quality, crisp print on fleece.
negative_prompt: huge front print, zipper (this is pullover), purple emblem, microphone, dollar sign, messy wrinkles, mannequin face, neon, low-res, watermark, extra logos, distorted text
notes: Pairs with hoodie back (big print). Front stays minimal; the back is the statement.
